node.label: fucosidosis
node.definition: Fucosidosis is an extremely rare lysosomal storage disorder characterized by a highly variable phenotype with common manifestations including neurologic deterioration, coarse facial features, growth retardation, and recurrent sinopulmonary infections, as well as seizures, visceromegaly, angiokeratoma and dysostosis.
synonyms: lysosomal storage disease caused by defective alpha-L-fucosidase with accumulation of fucose in the tissues

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)

neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. fucosidosis: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome: type 1 interferonopathy (innate immune activation) (via MONDO:0700264 type 1 interferonopathy). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.19. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for RNASEH2A, RNASEH2B, RNASEH2C, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
